name: Gabriella Coleman
biography: researches and teaches on the politics of free software, hackers, the law, and digital activism. Her first book, “Coding Freedom: The Aesthetics and the Ethics of Hacking” is forthcoming in November 2012 with Princeton University Press and she is currently working on a new book on Anonymous and digital activism. Twitter: @BiellaColeman
